chapters.name: IEEE Communications Society (ComSoc)
chapters.description: Promoting the advancement of science, technology and applications in communications and related disciplines.

chapters.name: IEEE Microwave Theory and Technology Society (MTT-S)
chapters.description: Promoting the advancement of microwave theory and its applications, including RF, microwave, millimeter-wave, and terahertz technologies.

chapters.name: IEEE Electron Devices Society (EDS)
chapters.description: To foster professional growth and advance the fields of electron and ion devices, encompassing all related technologies.

chapters.name: IEEE Antennas and Propagation Society (AP-S)
chapters.description: Promoting the advancement of antenna and propagation technologies, including their applications in communications, radar, and remote sensing.
